latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "Build Online Course Curriculum with Slides" skill.

- Generates structured curriculums including learning objectives, lesson content, slides, and assessments.
- Designed for educators, course creators, and corporate trainers building online educational content.
- Supports automated draft generation and content refinement.
- Integrates chat and presentation APIs for interactive content creation.
- Includes suggested prompts, workflow guidance, and SEO keywords for discoverability.
